sites.name: H-E-B San Antonio RSC (Fratt Road) - San Antonio TX

steps.step: Arrive at gate (no guard, kiosk or call box)

sites.dossierExcerpt:
Roster coordinates (29.486887, -98.392212, ROOFTOP) land at the NW corner of a
large solar-roofed warehouse — the H-E-B Retail Support Center. Satellite
probes at z15-z21 confirmed a large corporate distribution campus in NE San
Antonio, bounded by Fratt Rd / O'Connor Rd to the south, a public road to the
west, and residential subdivisions to the north and east. Web search (Waze,
chamber listings) corroborates "H-E-B Distribution Center, 6520 Fratt Rd,
78218", open 24/7, one of the region's largest employers. Locked working
center at the RSC warehouse: 29.486200, -98.389900.

fieldNotes.facility: Large H-E-B corporate distribution campus on Fratt Rd / O'Connor Rd, NE San Antonio. Solar-roofed RSC warehouse plus a print plant and multiple secondary buildings. Roster source notes the campus also includes milk plant / bakery functions; classified here as the integrated RSC campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link perimeter fence around the campus confirmed in Street View (2024-12). Truck entrance on the west road is a wide paved driveway with sliding fence-panel gates and yellow bollards; a tractor was captured mid-driveway. Counted as controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the west truck entrance. Large RSC campuses of this type often have a kiosk/remote check-in; classified remoteGs true. Low confidence — a guarded main entrance elsewhere on the campus cannot be ruled out from imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: RSC warehouse south face shows a long continuous bank of dock doors with trailers backed in; total across campus buildings well into 50+ band. Count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive paved drop yard south of the warehouse packed with parked H-E-B trailers (red-star livery confirmed in Street View). Well over 50 trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has the main solar-roofed RSC warehouse plus a print/mail-services plant and several other large buildings — a true multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Truck entrance driveway is very wide with unused paved width — room for a dedicated bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; campus bounded by residential to the north and roads on other sides.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~620 m E-W x ~630 m N-S); estimate.

sites.name: H-E-B eCommerce Fulfillment Center - Cibolo - Cibolo TX
sites.dossierExcerpt:
- Name: H-E-B eCommerce Fulfillment Center - Cibolo
- Type: E-commerce Fulfillment Center (~55,000 sq ft, opened May 2024)
- Address: 850 FM 1103, Cibolo, TX 78108
- Resolved coordinates: 29.568700, -98.230100 (store/eFC building centroid)

fieldNotes.facility: Cibolo eFC (~55,000 sq ft, opened May 2024) is integrated with the H-E-B Cibolo retail grocery store at 850 FM 1103 (store opened Jan 2023). Same model as the Plano eFC - not a stand-alone freight building.
fieldNotes.imagery: Google satellite tiles for this site are STALE - they show the site mid-construction (early foundation/grading), pre-2023. Audit relies on 2026-02 Street View (which confirms the store and eFC are built and operational, with H-E-B delivery vans and a curbside area on the SW face) plus the H-E-B store-attached-eFC pattern. Rear dock not directly visible.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled freight gate expected or visible. Truck access is a back-of-house service drive from the shopping-center parking-lot circulation - consistent with all H-E-B retail stores; no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint seen.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth - none visible and not part of the H-E-B store format.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~4 dock positions at the rear-of-store dock (slightly larger than a plain store dock because of the attached eFC). Banded 0-10. Estimate - not directly observed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Cibolo is a small city on the NE edge of the San Antonio metro; the site sits at a town-edge intersection (FM 1103 & Main St) with adjacent farmland and open land - judged Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Back-of-house service drive holds only 1-2 trucks at the dock.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: 1 box trailer glimpsed near the building in 2026-02 Street View; full count not observable.

sites.name: H-E-B Frisco Electronic Fulfillment Center (in development) - Frisco TX
sites.dossierExcerpt:
- Name: H-E-B Frisco Electronic Fulfillment Center (in development)
- Type: E-commerce Fulfillment Center (planned; construction 2026-2027)
- Address: FM 423 at US 380, Frisco, TX 75033
- Status: NOT YET BUILT — pre-construction.

fieldNotes.status: NOT YET BUILT. The H-E-B Frisco Electronic Fulfillment Center is a planned facility - per Community Impact (Dec 2025) and TDLR project TABS2026005469, construction is slated to begin July 2026 and complete June 2027. As of the audit date (May 2026) no EFC building exists; its truck yard, gate, and docks cannot be physically audited.
fieldNotes.location: The EFC will be a 51,599 sq ft building at FM 423 & US 380 (US 380 = University Dr) in Frisco, built adjacent to / on the parcel of the existing H-E-B Frisco store at 899 University Drive (130,000 sq ft store, opened Aug 2024). Coordinates locked to the existing H-E-B Frisco store building, the confirmed parcel; the EFC pad location within that parcel is not yet public.
fieldNotes.imagery: Current satellite shows the completed H-E-B Frisco big-box store with customer parking to the south and a back-of-house service dock on the north side facing a creek/drainage corridor. No EFC structure or its yard is present yet.
fieldNotes.expectedArchetype: Once built, the Frisco EFC is expected to follow H-E-B's store-attached-eFC pattern (cf. Plano idx 12, Cibolo idx 13): an open back-of-house service drive with no controlled freight gate or guard booth, and a small grocery-scale dock. This is an EXPECTATION, not an observation - all yard fields are listed in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.perimeter: The perimeter box drawn is the existing H-E-B Frisco store parcel (~23 acres) as a placeholder for the future EFC site; it is NOT a measured EFC geofence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the placeholder store-parcel perimeter, not the EFC itself.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Frisco / FM 423 & US 380 is a dense, fast-growing north Dallas-Fort Worth suburban retail corridor - Urban.

sites.name: H-E-B Hempstead Distribution Campus (in development) - Hempstead TX
sites.dossierExcerpt:
- Name: H-E-B Hempstead Distribution Campus (in development)
- Type: Distribution Campus (multi-phase; Phase 1 under construction)
- Address: Waller County, near Hempstead, TX 77445
- Status: UNDER CONSTRUCTION — Phase 1 site work only.

fieldNotes.status: UNDER CONSTRUCTION - Phase 1 only. Current satellite imagery confirms an active construction site: a large area (~400+ acres) of graded reddish earth, a sand/fill building pad being prepared, perimeter grading and construction staging (equipment, fill stockpiles, trucks). No completed distribution building, roof, dock doors, or defined truck yard exists yet. The truck gate, guard shack, docks, and yard cannot be physically audited.
fieldNotes.location: Positively located: the ~500-acre H-E-B distribution campus in Waller County, south of US 290 and east of SH 6, on the SW edge of Hempstead, immediately adjacent to the RCR Hempstead Logistics Rail Park (23639 Hwy 6). The roster's APPROXIMATE coordinate (30.097441, -96.078292) was the town centroid; corrected here to the construction site (30.105200, -96.064000).
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE (planned/expected). H-E-B's stated rationale: rail access was a key factor in the site selection - the campus is adjacent to the RCR Hempstead Logistics Rail Park on a Union Pacific Class I line. A rail spur into the campus is expected though not yet visible in the construction imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - this is explicitly a multi-phase distribution CAMPUS: Phase 1 ~750,000-900,000 sq ft distribution facility with 120-140 dock doors and a 20-30 acre yard (~$200M); Phase 2 adds 250,000-350,000 sq ft plus dedicated cold storage (2027); Phase 3 finishes parking/landscaping/stormwater. Multiple large buildings are planned.
fieldNotes.expectedScale: Once Phase 1 opens, the facility will be a very large gated freight DC - expect a controlled truck gate, guard shack and/or remote check-in, 120-140 dock doors (50+ band), a large drop yard, and rail service. These are EXPECTATIONS from the announced program, not observations - all such fields are in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-small-town / open Waller County farmland setting, ~50 miles NW of Houston - Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~423 acres measured from the currently-graded construction footprint; the full land purchase is ~500 acres.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 0 - no building is structurally complete yet in the imagery.
